remarks: Discover your new home at Dorlon Terrace in East Norwalk, CT! This charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo is located on the second floor, offering a sunny and bright living space. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry and stainless steel appliances in the well-appointed kitchen. Relax and soak up the sun on your private balcony, perfect for unwinding after a long day.    Situated within close proximity to the waterfront, this condo provides the perfect blend of comfort and accessibility. Dorlon Terrace residents also have access to fantastic amenities, including a heated pool and a pool house, perfect for relaxation and entertainment.  Don't miss this opportunity to live in a vibrant community with everything you need right at your doorstep!
